text:
jules: quick heads-up: someone left a half-empty jar of milk on the counter overnight and it's... suspicious. also kettle is making a weird squeal when it boils.

fern: oh no. squeal = limescale or loose lid seal? i can take a look after lunch.

kitchen-bot: [fridge-monitor] notice: dairy_items=1, temp=4.2C, last_door_open=2026-03-22T18:03Z

leo: half-empty jars are a personal trauma. can we switch to small single-serve cartons? less mystery.

ariel: cartons are fine but higher waste. what about labelled 1L glass with name sticker?

jules: poll time: react with :one: for single-serve cartons, :two: for labeled communal jar. i'll buy initial stash if we decide cartons.

paul: :one: — cartons, please. I'm not opening mystery jars ever again.

fern: :two: — jar, but labeled and locked behind the top shelf maybe? lol.

leo: :one: 

ariel: :two: but if we do jar, please label "TEAM MILK" not "MY MILK" (past trauma).

jules: current tally: cartons 2, jar 2 (so tied). i'll defer to facilities if tied. also planning to pick up decaf pods and dish soap at 13:00 unless anyone objects.

kitchen-bot: scheduled: "kitchen-supply-run" by jules at 2026-03-23T13:00Z

paul: can you add compostable spoons too? we ran out yesterday.

jules: adding compostable spoons + dish soap + 6 single-serve milk cartons (semiskimmed) + decaf pods. leaving receipt on the magnet.

fern: about the kettle squeal: if it's scale, pour 50/50 white vinegar+water, boil, let sit for 15min, rinse twice. i've done it before. want me to do it at 3pm?

ariel: tagging facilities: @facilities could you do a check on the kettle seal this week? might be a small repair.

leo: thanks jules! i'll toss my mystery jar into the bin if someone wants to claim it.

jules: picked up supplies. receipt on the fridge. left one carton in the fridge labeled "COMMUNAL: MILK (CARTON)" and a post-it: "If you prefer jar, move cartons to top shelf & stick name on jar."

fern: i'll do kettle descale at 15:00 — anyone who wants to learn, come at 3:05, quick demo.

paul: demo sounds good. also let's add a "kitchen etiquette" one-pager to the binder — short rules: label, clean, don't microwave fish.

ariel: agreed. i'll draft a friendly note + emoji and put in the binder.

jules: closing: thanks everyone. small wins for coffee morale. :coffee:
